common_instrumentation: Identical installed --cudagraph-metrics and source-pinned, per-thread device-bound V2 worker observer in both arms; append-only native dispatch decisions, resolved capture settings, and native capture memory. Decisions do not independently prove GPU completion; overhead is common and remains a limitation.
noise_rule: guardrail ratios straddling five percent are inconclusive; all beyond the guardrail reject
primary_formula: verified output tokens across valid measured requests divided by measured burst makespan, median of three matched repetition summaries
primary_pass: at both concurrency-eight lengths candidate >= 1.10 baseline, each paired repetition improves and candidate minimum exceeds baseline maximum
secondary: at each workload TTFT, decode TPOT and end-to-end latency regress no more than five percent; no new errors
